alt: Jaguar Type 01 electric GT on display at its New York reveal, a wide silver luxury car with sweeping lines
story: Jaguar's 2024 'Copy Nothing' rebrand campaign showed no cars at all, sent European sales crashing 97.5%, and on 7 Oct 2026 the company finally unveiled the £130,000 Type 01 EV in New York.
why_funny: A company that forgot to put cars in its own car commercial is now selling the most expensive car in its history.
